message: せつない色やね

name: Misasagi
message: 「For you to come visiting me, now that is a rare sight.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I only came because I have Student Council business today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you see, it's about the upcoming Holy Night Festival. We're currently gathering opinions from all sorts of people.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Another year is already coming to an end, isn't it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And in a few months, the third term will end and you'll graduate. Good riddance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, come on.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If possible, I'd love it if you stopped coming by the shop too.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Things are going to turn out just the way you want, so don't get all worked up like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... hey, what's that supposed to mean?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Once I graduate from here, I'm going somewhere far, far away.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are you actually worrying about me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I care what happens to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, please don't tease Nanaka too much. She's a good person at heart.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I already know that without you having to tell me.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is it really true?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This really is the last one, isn't it? It feels like a dream, even though I've known it was coming for a long time.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Please don't tell Rii-a. I'll tell her myself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wouldn't even bring you up in conversation!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, never mind about me. More importantly, we were talking about the Holy Night Festival, yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, yes」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I really want to dance」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, the dance party, right? Same as last year」
At the campfire after the Holy Night Festival, we danced folk-dance style to songs like Jingle Bells.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I don't wanna do Jingle Bells」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Jingle Bells ain't a bad song or nothin'. Still, don'tcha think it's got no mood to it? Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mood, huh...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yeah. Mood is super important, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True...

name: Nanaka
message: I-It's not like I'm agreeing with your opinion or anything! I was just thinking the exact same thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mood... mood...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, don't force yourself to understand. That's what you're worst at, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Argh...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You don't gotta force yourself to understand」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just accept that!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ya see, mood is somethin' that naturally wells up when things are goin' well between two people」

name: Synn
message: 「I see!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And that's where dancin' comes in」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get how 'that's where' connects, yet it's so convincing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even you, nitpickin' every little thing over there, surely have someone you'd like to dance with, don'tcha?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, ah」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I have anyone like that!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a troublesome person」

name: Paqy
message: 「No kidding」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So there isn't anyone...」
While feeling relieved, there's also a sense of disappointment that I'm not included either.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Are you relieved?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Uh, well, you know...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've gotten pretty cute lately, so bad bugs have started swarming around me, you see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well. As my childhood friend, I thought maybe you'd be worried about my safety or something」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, of course...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is that so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I've never seen any bugs like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wagyan!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「All that aside, dancing isn't a bad way to quietly show romantic feelings you normally can't confess, either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see...」
There is someone. Someone like that.
Then it's only natural she wants to forget about kissing me...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, you're just using me as an excuse to get your own wish granted, aren't you! You said 'either' just now, didn't you. 'Either'」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You sure sweat the small stuff」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well. With a rotten personality like yours, you probably don't have a chance anyway」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Probably not」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're aware of it?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's not an issue with my personality, you know. I've got a wonderful, angel-like personality, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's Ria」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Like I said, it's Ria. The one I want to dance with」

name: Synn
message: 「As proof of your friendship?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I won't say that's not part of it. Though, it's a little more earthy than that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaaaat?! Y-You swing that way?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I didn't think I had those kinds of tastes either, you know, it just so happens the one I fell for is Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... wait, whaaat?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your reaction's way too slow!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, I can't tell her. If Ria found out a friend who's leaving after this year had those kinds of feelings for her, it'd only put her in a tough spot」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's so heartbreaking... Even so, at the very least, I want to make some good memories at the end」
As she said that, my senior cast a somewhat dreamy, melancholic gaze.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I don't really get that kind of stuff, but d-do your best, I guess」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're not gonna tease me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Falling for someone is... well, you can't help it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really are a good kid, aren't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Shut up!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, and by the way, all that stuff I was just saying--that was all a lie」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Every bit of it was a lie」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't mess with me!」
